superseded_measurements.method: differenced the last dates of two stores fetched to different end bounds (fundamentals capped at the sealed-holdout MAX_END=2025-04-15; klines fetched to present, 2026-07-02)
differenced fetch date against store last observation, which is the deliberate holdout cap (MAX_END=2025-04-15) rather than the vendor frontier

probes.correction_rationale: the store is truncated at MAX_END by design, so publication lag cannot be derived from its endpoint; the vendor frontier is captured at fetch time (catalog endpoint, not subject to --end truncation) and compared against the fetch date

live_verification.note: independent live check against CoinMetrics wall clock, run by the coordinator outside this probe and outside the on-disk holdout-capped fundamentals store; confirms the registered t-2 convention is conservative for the true vendor lag

probes.note: cheap-minus-expensive gross daily spread must be positive for at least one metric
